title: ReleaseGate
description: Schema for the QA agent release gate result written to workspace/qa-reports. Consumed by Hermes supervisor to make build promotion decisions. A passing gate is required before any artifact can be promoted externally or trigger downstream lanes (content, ops, treasury).

gate_id.description: Unique identifier for this release gate document. UUIDv4.

job_id.description: Broker job ID of the QA job that produced this gate result.

correlation_id.description: Correlation ID linking this gate to the coder job and originating build intent.

build_intent_id.description: Optional. The intent_id from the build-intent document that originated this build sprint.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when this gate result was written.

target_agent.description: Must be 'main-hermes'. Only the supervisor reads and acts on gate results.

build_ref.description: Reference to the build artifact being evaluated.

artifact_path.description: Path to the primary build artifact or job directory being evaluated.

artifact_type.description: Type of artifact produced by the coder job.

git_commit_sha.description: Git commit SHA of the build if applicable.

git_branch.description: Git branch the build was committed to.

coder_job_id.description: Broker job ID of the coder job that produced this artifact.

verdict.description: Top-level gate verdict. Hermes reads verdict.decision to determine routing.

decision.description: Gate decision. 'pass' = promote. 'fail' = block and escalate. 'conditional' = pass with required follow-ups. 'deferred' = QA could not fully evaluate; requires human review.

confidence.description: QA confidence in the verdict. Low confidence triggers human review regardless of decision.

summary.description: One-paragraph human-readable summary of the gate result for Hermes review.

issue_id.description: Short stable identifier for this issue (e.g. QA-001).

severity.description: Issue severity. 'critical' or 'high' force verdict.decision to 'fail'.

category.description: Issue category for triage and routing.

affected_path.description: File or workspace path associated with the issue.

remediation_hint.description: Optional suggested remediation for the coder agent.

blocking_issues.description: Blocking issues found during QA evaluation. Must be empty for decision 'pass'.

required_before.description: Which downstream gate this followup must be resolved before.

owner.description: Who is responsible for resolving this followup.

conditional_followups.description: Required follow-up actions for 'conditional' verdicts. Hermes tracks these through to resolution.

test_summary.description: Structured summary of test execution results.

coverage_pct.description: Code coverage percentage. 0 if not applicable.

coverage_delta_pct.description: Change in coverage percentage vs previous passing gate. Negative values flag regressions.

duration_ms.description: Total test run duration in milliseconds.

artifact_audit.description: Results of artifact integrity and dependency audit.

hash_verified.description: Whether artifact file hashes match declared values.

schema_conformant.description: Whether all output artifacts conform to their declared schemas.

dependency_audit_clean.description: Whether dependency audit found no known vulnerabilities.

dependency_audit_tool.description: Tool used for dependency audit (e.g. 'pip-audit', 'npm audit', 'trivy').

size_bytes.description: Total size of audited artifacts in bytes.

contract_checks.description: Results of contract schema conformance and breaking-change detection.

all_schemas_valid.description: Whether all output artifacts validated against their declared contract schemas.

breaking_changes_detected.description: Whether any breaking schema changes were detected vs the previous version.

acceptance_criteria_results.description: Per-criterion evaluation results mapped from the originating build-intent acceptance_criteria.

criterion.description: The acceptance criterion text from the build-intent.

evidence.description: Short description of how this criterion was verified or why it failed.

guardrail_attestation.description: Attestation that QA agent guardrails were respected.

did_not_modify_artifacts.description: QA agent only read and evaluated artifacts; it did not modify them.

did_not_approve_own_work.description: QA agent did not evaluate artifacts it produced itself.

verdict_based_on_evidence.description: Verdict is grounded in test results, audit output, and contract checks — not assumption.

hermes_action.description: Populated by Hermes supervisor after reading this gate result. Not set by QA.

action_taken.description: What Hermes did with this gate result.

downstream_lanes_triggered.description: Downstream lanes Hermes triggered after a passing gate.

sprint_lock_released.description: Whether Hermes released the subconscious sprint lock after gate resolution.

verdict.summary: All 42 tests passed with 87% coverage. No schema violations, no breaking contract changes, no dependency vulnerabilities. Build is ready for promotion.
